description_en: Moves a resource to a different resource group
kebab_example: aliyun alikafka change-resource-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-id alikafka_post-cn-v0h1fgs20000 --new-resource-group-id rg-ac000000000007q --api-version 2019-09-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ChangeResourceGroup

parameters.description_en: The region ID of the resource.
parameters.help_en: The region ID of the resource
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the resource to be tagged. Currently, only instance-level tagging is supported.

For example, if the instance ID is alikafka\_post-cn-v0h1fgs2xxxx, the resource ID is alikafka\_post-cn-v0h1fgs2xxxx.
parameters.description_zh:
需要打标的资源ID 。目前仅支持实例级别。

例如：实例ID为alikafka_post-cn-v0h1fgs2xxxx，则资源ID为alikafka_post-cn-v0h1fgs2xxxx。

parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the resource group to which you want to move the cloud resource instance.

> Resource groups are a mechanism for grouping and managing resources under an Alibaba Cloud account, which helps you solve the complexity of resource grouping and authorization management within a single cloud account. For more information, see [Resource Management](~~94475~~).
parameters.description_zh:
需要移入云资源实例的资源组ID。

> 资源组是在阿里云账号下进行资源分组管理的一种机制，资源组能够帮助您解决单个云账号内的资源分组和授权管理等复杂性问题。更多信息，请参见[什么是资源管理](~~94475~~)。
